topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: In a cash account, you must pay the full amount for securities purchased.
answer: When opening a brokerage account, you may be asked to choose between a cash account and a margin account. With a cash account, you pay the full purchase price and do not borrow from the brokerage firm. With a margin account, you borrow money from the firm to buy securities; the securities serve as collateral, and you pay interest on the loan. Margin can increase your purchasing power, but it can also expose you to larger losses. Since some applications may set margin as the default, confirm which account type you are opening before signing.
